column1: # Paths are site paths as written in site/ (folder index pages as /x/index.html).
# Decided by hand under the rule: a page whose content a visitor could not tell apart from
# another page's is not a separate page.
# Drafts and second saves of a page beside it (front-page drafts, x.htm saved again as x.html): the
# differences are dates, navigation or a few words; a passage the kept page lacks is merged into it.
# The /donnie(s)/ mirror and folders copied inside other folders. Where their pictures differ, the
# copy's file is damaged or missing (see media_twins.tsv) or the picture is on another page already;
# a picture shown nowhere else (Kaufman's jurgen/ copy) is merged into the kept page.
# The same picture twice in a slide sequence: the repeat goes to its first showing; the exhibit
# Near copies in other folders: the same page with other dates, prices, years or small wording.
# Old 'Main galleries' index snapshots go to one; the artists only another snapshot lists are merged in.
# Artists' comments saved again in other years: the earliest is kept; later additions are merged in.
# The McCormack comments page shows Simon Levin's biography, so it goes to Levin's page.
# Contest forms and notices saved again: payment forms, thank-you pages, open-gallery indexes.
# Callado's gallery shows exactly the eleven pictures of Delgado's 'Flashlight Art' gallery (and
# Callado's comments page says 'No comments'): one gallery, Delgado's.
# Kept as separate pages: genuinely different content under similar addresses or wording
# (entry-fee vs catalog payment form; different artworks; different winners; different picture sets).
